headline: Top drug dealer Pichi Raja escapes prison van using bathroom break
summary: Known as a top drug dealer in Mohammadpur, the suspect escaped while being transported to Kashimpur Central Jail on Sunday night.
details: A top drug dealer known as 'Pichi Raja' escaped from a prison van on Sunday night. He was being transported from court to Kashimpur Central Jail.

caption:
A top drug dealer escaped from police custody during a bathroom break. How did he slip away?

A top drug dealer known as 'Pichi Raja' escaped from a prison van on Sunday night. He was being transported from court to Kashimpur Central Jail.

The escape happened in front of the Naujoor Highway Police Station in Gazipur. Pichi Raja, also known as Badsha, requested a bathroom break, and police officers took him out of the van.

Taking advantage of the moment, the suspect fled the scene while the officers were accompanying him to the restroom.

Police identified the suspect as a top drug dealer from the Mohammadpur area of Dhaka. He has multiple cases against him, including murder and attempted murder.

Pichi Raja had been arrested on May 19 of this year after returning from Nepal to Bangladesh via Shahjalal International Airport.

The incident has raised questions about security during the transition of high-profile prisoners to the jail.

Police are currently searching for the fugitive drug dealer.

headline_marked: 3 jailed after [[rampage at Dhaka property project]] causes Tk 29m loss
headline: 3 jailed after rampage at Dhaka property project causes Tk 29m loss
summary: Attackers fired 50 rounds and looted valuables from New Gini Properties and a content creator's studio in South Manikdi.
details: A Dhaka court has sent three people to jail following their arrest in a case involving vandalism, looting, and theft at the New Gini Properties housing project in South Manikdi, near ECB Chattar.

The attack occurred around 10:30 pm on Saturday, where approximately 50 attackers trespassed onto the project site. They reportedly fired around 50 rounds of gunfire and used machetes, daggers, and sticks to launch the assault.

The miscreants targeted the project office and a studio called 'Brownfish' belonging to content creator Salman Muqtadir. Several people, including site engineer Md Parvez, sustained severe injuries during the rampage.

New Gini Properties authority claims the vandalism caused damage worth approximately Tk 14 million, while stolen property, including cash, laptops, and professional media equipment, is valued at Tk 15 million.
Police from Cantonment Police Station responded to the scene, where attackers opened fire on them. Officers fired five shotgun rounds in self-defence to bring the situation under control.
Three suspects—Md Mamun, Md Aslam, and Md Munna—were arrested and produced in court on Sunday. Local weapons and spent bullet casings were recovered from them.

The attack is believed to have stemmed from an ongoing land dispute between a property developer and a retired military officer. A case has been filed against 10 named individuals and up to 200 unnamed suspects.
